_doc: Post-freeze additions (M3a). (1) From the read-only sample on real services: a GENERIC base type with many bean subclasses is a framework extension point, not a variation point. (2) From the rule-mutation pass: the frozen fixture never isolates a Map-only registry or a factory-only selector (every such port also had a List), so those rules carried no weight; these cases isolate them. Kept apart from the frozen expected.json so the original ground truth stays unchanged.
